title: A physical tag for the chosen mode
description: Tie the action to a separate object, explaining the available limits and exceptions in advance.

blocks.text: A person chooses the apps and the access mode in advance, and a separate physical tag makes changing that mode a deliberate action. The object can stay in a particular place, creating a pause between the urge to open the feed and the return of access.

quote.text: I loved the idea of the brick when it came out but the price point is ridiculous. I tried every other app blocker possible and nothing, and I mean NOTHING, worked until foqos.

blocks.text: An action with an object as the boundary

Before the start, the terms have to be clear: when the limit is in force, what lifts it and which exceptions are provided for. The scenario is tested on a real device, including a trip without the tag; there must be no promise that the block is impossible to get around.
Testing a day away from home

Reviews show interest in a physical mechanic, but they do not confirm the value of every new accessory. First it is worth testing whether the arrangement itself gets used again, and the cost of the inconvenience when plans change suddenly.
